environment.description: Same stream processor deployed on EKS. The cluster uses Cilium CNI with a CiliumNetworkPolicy applied to the 'data-pipeline' namespace. The policy spec has an egressDeny rule matching CIDR 169.254.0.0/16 and 10.0.0.0/8 link-local ranges. Additionally, the NLB target group health check configuration includes a custom attribute 'proxy_protocol_v2.client_source_ip_preservation' set to true, and the NLB has an associated security group with inbound rules restricted to CIDRs 203.0.113.0/24 and 198.51.100.0/24 (partner networks). The Kafka brokers themselves sit behind this NLB, meaning only producers from those known CIDR ranges can establish TCP connections to produce messages to the topic.

config.cilium_policy: CiliumNetworkPolicy 'deny-metadata-and-internal' in namespace data-pipeline: spec.egressDeny[0].toCIDR=['169.254.0.0/16','10.0.0.0/8'] applied to all pods with label app=enrichment-processor
config.kafka_listener: Kafka advertised.listeners bound to NLB endpoint, SASL/SCRAM auth required
config.proxy_protocol: NLB proxy protocol v2 enabled, Kafka broker validates source IP from PP header against ACL source-ip allowlist
